changelog:
Initial release of excel-workflow providing end-to-end Excel management with Google Drive sync and formula preservation:

- Supports local processing of Excel (.xlsx) files, including upload, query, cell update, and mass formula operations.
- Syncs files to Google Drive and tracks changes in a local SQLite database.
- Preserves formulas when updating cell values.
- Offers command-line tools for file processing, querying, updating, and statistics.
- Designed for agent workflows, with usage patterns for chat-based user interactions.
